summary: Tested backend + frontend article scope against external URL. Clone integrity checks passed for all 3 published articles (slugs/title/body DOM/media hashes), article-media hardening passed, home/artigos/detail flows validated on desktop and mobile, admin preview sanitization passed. One UI gap found in admin editor for explicit content_format switching.

ui_bugs.issue: No visible control to explicitly switch content_format between html/markdown in UI (selector count 0 for expected format control), limiting manual CRUD coverage for temporary HTML article creation via admin interface.

action_items: Add explicit admin UI control for content_format (html/markdown) with stable data-testid and persist it during edit/save.
After adding format control, retest admin-only CRUD for temporary HTML + Markdown records end-to-end through UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin credentials are hardcoded constants in backend/server.py; move to environment variables for production safety.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary article TEMP_MD_ARTICLE_ITER2 during admin validation; removed via cleanup regression test. Additional TEMP_ records cleaned and none left published.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression for article clone integrity now lives in test_articles_clone_integrity.py (18 passing tests). Mobile and desktop checks validated 3-article listing/detail, related links (2 each), no horizontal overflow at 1920x800 and 390x844, and sanitized preview behavior (script/onerror/javascript blocked). If admin format toggle is implemented, rerun pytest + admin Playwright CRUD path.
rca of the issue: Repro: login /admin, click + Novo artigo, inspect editor fields. No control exists to select content_format; only textarea label changes based on existing state. Impact: manual admin workflow cannot intentionally create a temporary HTML article from scratch to validate format transitions entirely in UI. Mitigation: add format selector bound to form.content_format and include it in create/update payloads with regression test coverage.
